programs.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Promeo, Promeo!
programs.desc: Shaun and Tom investigate whether someone who claims to be a cat's owner really is  Tom attempts to reunite a feline with his canine companion  brittle tree makes things tough on a night rescue.

programs.title: Carter's W.A.R.: The Heart of the Conflict
programs.desc: Investigating a string of murdered lions, Ivan gets to the very heart of an ancient conflict between humans and lions. The outcome will test Ivan's own core values about cultural perspective and conservation.

programs.title: Sharkcam Strikes Back
programs.desc: From napping great white sharks to SharkCam attacks, a showcase of the remarkable discoveries made by the team in the past six years as well as a tongue-in-cheek look at some of the disasters.

programs.title: The Zoo: Snow Monkey Social
programs.desc: A new bison calf has a hard time keeping up with his mom  the bird department prepares a group of Von der Decken hornbill chicks for their move to the Minnesota Zoo  keepers at the Central Park Zoo hope the female snow monkeys accept a new male.

programs.title: My Cat From Hell: Ferocious Foster
programs.desc: Jackson meets an outdoor cat who, having been forced to live inside, has protested by soaking the place in pee  a desperate foster guardian resorts to Jackson as her only hope to save a cat from being euthanized.

programs.title: I Was Prey: Blood in the Water
programs.desc: A grizzly bear charges taxidermist Wilf Lloyd while he hunts elk with his son-in-law in the Canadian Rocky Mountains  miles from shore, diving 180 feet below the surface, spearfisher Anthony Segrich finds a bull shark charging toward him.

programs.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Robert's Python Swim
programs.desc: Robert gets in the water with Gloria, a 12-foot reticulated python, to swim alongside her for the first time in the Crocoseum  Bindi welcomes home two orphaned kangaroo joeys  Terri helps release a rescued wedge-tailed eagle back into the wild.
